# Released project skill fingerprints

Exact complete-bundle SHA256 manifests from released checkpoint templates and static
skills in Git history. Keep historical entries when adding a release. Codex entries
include the plain and converted frontmatter produced by prior generators. Matching
requires every file and executable bit; names alone never establish ownership.
